description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); CREATE TABLE R (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_R PRIMARY KEY, T1 TEXT(255), T2 TEXT(255), T3 TEXT(255), T4 TEXT(255), T5 TEXT(255), T6 TEXT(255), T7 TEXT(255), T8 TEXT(255), M MEMO); Close. One shared session adds ID 1 through a table recordset (AddNew/Update) with 1980 U+20AC characters (3960 bytes) across T1..T8 and M of 30 U+20AC characters (60 bytes; row with 12-byte external ref is 4002 bytes, with 60-byte inline M would be 4062 bytes) and closes. Page 0 bytes 3584-3591, page 1 and pages 42-53 are read after create and after insert (pages 0-55 hashed), and M's FieldSize read back. Asks whether ACE pushes the 60-byte Memo to an LVAL page when the row has less than 64 bytes of record space left, or fails with error 3047.
retentionNote: r-q22-lv-open: R-FMT-2 long-value open cases (ACE 2007 ACCDB)
